OBSERVED AUTHOR AI TRIAL
One screenshot-based high-five attempt missed its live window. See the capture ↗ · raw log ↗
Author-assisted, not an independent benchmark. Wobble was hardened after this run.

Experimental client-side demo.
Not a production authentication boundary.
How the handshake works +

01 / The vibe. A randomized, culturally light everyday question. No points for pretending language models can’t answer these.

02 / The wobble. Track a fresh moving disco ball for 1.4 seconds. A static screenshot or a one-off click is insufficient. Keyboard and touch work too.

03 / The high five. Wait for a hand to appear, then react inside its live window. Relaxed mode doubles the reaction window. A new cue and position are generated each time.

The catch. This demonstrator keeps all checks in the browser. A source-aware adversary can bypass it; production needs server-issued challenges and server-side verification. Bot-bench controls are labeled by what they actually measure.
